product_overview: Hi Line Pro Care is a localized e-commerce storefront for cosmetic and personal care products, paired with an administrative dashboard for managing catalog, orders, customers, promotions, and store configuration. Customers can browse in Arabic or English, shop products, place orders, and track them, while managers can oversee operations and reporting from the admin area.
core_goals: Browse the storefront in Arabic or English with localized URLs and preserved page context
Discover products through search, category browsing, sorting, and product detail views
Add products to cart, adjust quantities, apply coupons, and place an order
Track an order using order number and phone number
Access customer account features such as order history, wishlist, and addresses after signing in
Allow administrators to log in and manage products, categories, orders, customers, coupons, inventory, and fulfillment
Provide administrators with analytics, activity logs, notifications, media, SEO, settings, and backup tools

features.name: Localized Storefront Navigation
features.description: Customers can browse the storefront in Arabic or English, with localized URLs and page-preserving language switching.
user_flows: Navigate to /ar -> Browse the Arabic storefront home -> Switch to English -> See the same page in English at the localized URL
Navigate to /en -> Browse the English storefront home -> Switch to Arabic -> See the same page in Arabic at the localized URL
Open a localized storefront link directly -> Browse the page in the selected language -> Continue navigating within the same locale

features.name: Product Discovery
features.description: Customers can search, filter, sort, and open products from the catalog, then inspect details, variants, and quantity options.
user_flows: Navigate to /ar/shop -> Browse the catalog -> Search for a product -> Filter by category -> Sort the results -> Open a product -> Choose a variant and quantity -> Review product details
Navigate to /en/shop -> Browse the catalog -> Select a category -> Narrow the product list -> Sort the results -> Open a product -> Review related products and available options
Navigate to /ar/shop/category/:category -> View a category-filtered catalog -> Adjust search or sorting -> Open a product detail page -> Inspect product information

features.name: Cart and Checkout
features.description: Customers can manage cart contents, apply coupons, enter delivery and customer details, and place an order.
user_flows: Navigate to /ar/shop/:slug -> Open a product -> Choose a variant and quantity -> Add item to cart -> Navigate to /ar/cart -> Change quantity -> Continue to checkout -> Complete customer and delivery details -> Apply a coupon -> Place order -> See order confirmation
Navigate to /en/cart -> Review items in the cart -> Remove an item -> Change another item quantity -> Continue to checkout -> Fill in checkout information -> Place order -> See order confirmation
Navigate to /ar/checkout -> Enter checkout details -> Apply a valid coupon -> Review totals and delivery information -> Place order -> See order confirmation
Navigate to /ar/checkout -> Enter checkout details -> Apply a coupon code with invalid format -> See coupon validation feedback -> Correct the coupon code -> Continue checkout

features.name: Order Confirmation and Tracking
features.description: Customers can review a newly placed order and track an order by entering the order number and phone number.
user_flows: Navigate to /ar/order-confirmation -> Review the placed order summary -> See the next actions for the order
Navigate to /ar/track-order -> Enter order number -> Enter customer phone number -> Submit tracking request -> Review order status
Navigate to /en/track-order -> Enter order number -> Enter customer phone number -> Submit tracking request -> Review order status

features.name: Customer Authentication and Account
features.description: Customers can log in, request a password reset, complete a reset, and manage account information after signing in.
user_flows: Navigate to /ar/login -> Enter account credentials -> Log in -> Access the customer account area -> Review profile and order information
Navigate to /ar/forgot-password -> Enter account email -> Request a password reset -> Proceed to the reset-password flow -> Complete the password reset form -> Return to sign in
Navigate to /ar/account -> See the sign-in requirement -> Log in with valid customer credentials -> Open account tabs -> Review orders, wishlist, and addresses
Navigate to /ar/account -> See the sign-in requirement -> Enter invalid customer credentials at sign in -> See login validation feedback -> Correct the credentials -> Log in successfully

features.name: Admin Authentication and Dashboard
features.description: Administrators can sign in to the protected dashboard, open admin sections, and manage the store from a central shell.
user_flows: Navigate to /admin/login -> Enter administrator credentials -> Log in -> Open the admin dashboard -> Navigate to an admin section
Navigate to /admin/login -> Enter invalid administrator credentials -> See login validation feedback -> Correct the credentials -> Log in -> Open the dashboard
Navigate to /admin -> See the protected access requirement -> Sign in as administrator -> Enter the dashboard -> Open another admin section

features.name: Admin Commerce Operations
features.description: Administrators can manage the store catalog, categories, orders, customers, coupons, inventory, fulfillment, and dropshipping workflows.
user_flows: Navigate to /admin/products -> Review the product list -> Create or edit a product -> Save changes -> See the updated catalog entry
Navigate to /admin/categories -> Review categories -> Create or edit a category -> Save changes -> See the updated category list
Navigate to /admin/orders -> Review orders -> Open an order -> Update the order status -> See the updated order record
Navigate to /admin/customers -> Review customer records -> Open a customer profile -> Inspect associated details
Navigate to /admin/coupons -> Review coupons -> Create or edit a coupon -> Save changes -> See the updated coupon list
Navigate to /admin/inventory-movements -> Review stock movement history -> Inspect recent adjustments and sales entries
Navigate to /admin/fulfillment -> Review fulfillment tasks -> Update fulfillment progress -> Continue managing shipments
Navigate to /admin/dropshipping -> Review dropshipping items and workflows -> Update operational details

features.name: Admin Analytics and Configuration
features.description: Administrators can review analytics, inspect logs, manage media and notifications, adjust SEO and store settings, manage admin users, and export or back up data.
user_flows: Navigate to /admin/analytics -> Review revenue, orders, and category performance -> Inspect low-stock signals -> Return to the dashboard
Navigate to /admin/activity-logs -> Review administrative actions -> Inspect a specific log entry -> Return to another admin tool
Navigate to /admin/notifications -> Review notifications -> Update notification management settings -> Continue to another configuration page
Navigate to /admin/media-library -> Review media assets -> Manage library items -> Use the assets in store content
Navigate to /admin/seo -> Review SEO settings -> Adjust store metadata -> Save changes
Navigate to /admin/settings -> Review store settings -> Update shipping rates or active payment methods -> Save changes
Navigate to /admin/admin-users -> Review administrator accounts -> Manage admin access -> Return to the admin area
Navigate to /admin/export-backup -> Export data or create a backup -> Review the generated export options

known_limitations.impact: Protected admin routes can only be verified through redirect and login behavior unless a valid test account is supplied.

known_limitations.impact: Live payment completion cannot be exercised without a configured sandbox provider.
